name: Match box
summary: Before 1900 cigarettes were not common in China, still less a match box as part of a smoking set. With the growing number of Western firms trading in China since 1900 European-style objects began to appear in Chinese households as well. A cloisonné  match box would have appealed to a wealthy Chinese
